## Core Competencies & Deep Dives
### Backend Architecture & Distributed Systems
- AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM): Design and deployment of event-driven architectures leveraging AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS, and EventBridge.
- Microservices & Monolith Hybrid: Decoupling core business boundaries into independent functions with shared Lambda layers for dependencies and uniform secrets management.
- Concurrency & Performance: In-memory caching with Redis, query optimization and migration management with Prisma and PostgreSQL, document modeling with MongoDB.

### Full Stack & Web Engineering
- Node.js & TypeScript: Idiomatic static typing, microservice orchestrations, resilient REST APIs.
- Frontend: React 19, Next.js, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS v4, smooth scroll physics with Lenis.
- AI Integration: Multimodal voice and LLM workflows utilizing Google Gemini API for real-time interview generation.

## Project Case Studies
